opening: Check attendance, punctuality, uniform, grooming and hand hygiene; report any staffing gap.
Assign sections, host desk, service stations and cashier duties; confirm break cover.
Read the last shift handover; assign an owner to unresolved guest or maintenance issues.
Brief the team on reservations, parties, special requests and guest allergy notes.
Confirm menu availability, sold-out items, specials and current offers with kitchen/bar; brief staff.
Walk the entrance and dining floor: clean, dry, no odour, pests, broken items or trip hazards.
Check tables, chairs and upholstery; clean and set each table to the outlet standard.
Inspect plates, glasses and cutlery: clean, dry, polished and free of chips or cracks.
Check menus and bill folders are clean, complete and show the current prices.
Restock service stations: napkins, trays, serviceware, condiments and drinking-water supplies.
Check guest washrooms for cleanliness, working fittings, soap, tissue and a dry floor.
Check lighting, music and guest comfort; report faults, leaks or damp areas.
Keep exits, walkways and access to safety equipment clear; report any obstruction.
Check POS, order routing/printers, paper, internet and payment devices; flag faults before service.
Count and record the opening cash float with the cashier; record any mismatch.
Confirm reservations, seating plan and table numbers; check any takeaway/collection desk if used.
Confirm who can approve discounts, complimentary (NC), voids and refunds under existing rules.
Confirm allergy requests will be checked with kitchen/bar; do not promise unverified ingredients.
Check spacing at two-top tables; keep chairs and service routes clear.
Recheck housekeeping handover, washrooms and the dining floor before the first guest.
closing: Confirm all guests have left and service is complete; do not start disruptive closing work early.
Check all tables and open orders; record any unpaid or pending bill and the handover owner.
Check each bill against the correct payment mode; investigate mismatches before final reports.
Reconcile cash, cards, UPI and other accepted payments against POS and settlement records.
Review discounts, NC/complimentary bills, voids, cancellations and refunds with reasons and approvals.
Count closing cash; record float, sales, expenses, deposits and balance, with supporting bills.
Secure cash and hand over keys/valuables to the designated person under existing procedure.
Prepare the daily sales report (DSR), covers and exceptions; check figures before sharing.
Clear tables and stations; return used serviceware for washing and reset for the next shift.
Check tables, chairs, upholstery, menus, bill folders and host desk are clean and dry.
Check clean serviceware is dry, undamaged and stored properly; log shortages and breakages.
Clean and restock FOH stations; store condiments and service supplies as instructed.
Confirm guest washrooms are cleaned and restocked; remove waste to the designated area.
Count designated high-value FOH/bar items with the responsible staff member, where applicable.
Check under tables and seating for lost property; log and secure any items found.
Log guest complaints, incidents, maintenance faults and shortages with owner and follow-up time.
Hand over next-day bookings, parties, special requests, pending bills and stock requirements.
Check with kitchen/bar/security before final lock-up; confirm their closing handover is complete.
Switch off only assigned non-essential FOH equipment; leave required refrigeration/safety systems on.
Complete the final walk: no one left inside, no leaks or hazards; secure doors/keys as instructed.
Check the daily cash record and expense vouchers agree; record any unresolved difference.
Prepare the checked DSR for the Embassy DSR Promenade reporting channel.
